hook: A new method maps 24 cell types continuously across the human cortex from gene expression data
summary: RIDGE combines regional reference data with cortex-wide gene expression maps to estimate where 24 cortical cell types sit. The maps held up across pipelines and reference datasets and reproduced a known sensory-to-allocortical gradient. The cell-type distributions are statistical estimates inferred from transcriptomics, not direct cell counts.
title: A spatially continuous cell-type atlas reveals multiscale organization of the human cortex
